title: The case-side slice of the field-capture path rests on answers no source specifies: the stage and route fields of the case resource, the authorise call shape, the contract story of the checklist read, and the task data
source: Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 8 and 10; Ownership Map v1 (api rows for P3 rwb-case, P4 rwb-access, P5 rwb-document); legacy story RWB-E2-024 sections 3, 4, 7, 11, 12 and 13; FSD P3 Case and workflow v4 A1.5, A2.22 and A2.23; TSD P3 Case and workflow v3 T3.1 and T-A.1; TSD P5 Document hub v2 T-A.1
section: s3 Preconditions; s7 Acceptance criteria note; s8 Business rules; s10 Authority; s11 Data; s12.1 REST operations provided; s12.2 REST operations consumed; s13 Solution plan (configuration and reference data)
description: One combined row for this story, because four missing details all block the same slice. First, this slice answers the case's stage code DF-CAS-006 and route code DF-CAS-008 so the document checklist can be read, but the published Case resource of RWB-P3-E1018-CON names twelve fields and none of them is stageCode or routeCode, although the range it cites (DF-CAS-001 to DF-CAS-023) covers both; no source fixes the field names, the flags or the optionality. Second, the authorise call to POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise carries the caller, the case, the area DOCUMENTS, the right C and the caller's case activity as the OWN evidence, but neither Architecture v5 slide 8 nor TSD P4 v3 gives the request or response shape, so the client, the fake and the message mapping to 403 MSG-P4-002 and 404 MSG-P4-003 cannot be fixed. Third, the completeness answer is read from the document hub's checklist operation API-P5-008, and the story that publishes that baseline is not named in the sources or in the Ownership Map, so the C dependency set of this story names RWB-P5-E2024-CON only and the checklist read is bound to the operation, not to a named contract story. Fourth, the task this slice raises needs a task code, an owner role, a discretion, a due-date parameter key and its value, a decision code and a checklist version label, and no source gives any of them; the values in the file (CHK-2026.11, HUMAN_TASK, REQUIRED, OPEN, WORKBENCH) are test and list values, and the checklist version label is a sample only.
evidence: RWB-P3-E1018-CON section 12.1: the Case resource is id, caseNo, productGroup, primaryPersonKey, status, entryDate, dpdAtEntry, exposureBand, totalOutstandingAtEntry, deviationOpen, legalHold, taken from DF-CAS-001 to DF-CAS-023; TSD P3 v3 T3.1: DF-CAS-006 stage_code and DF-CAS-008 route_code exist in recovery_case; TSD P3 v3 T-A.1: API-P3-002 GET /cases/{caseId} and API-P3-003 GET /cases/{caseId}/timeline; Architecture v5 slide 10 names GET /v1/cases/{id}, GET /v1/customers/{id} and GET /v1/accounts/{id} but no authorise operation; legacy RWB-E2-024 section 12 gives POST /cases/{caseId}/field-captures and the in-process interfaces MalwareScanService, DocumentStore and CaseDirectory, with no task data; TSD P5 v2 T-A.1 gives API-P5-008 GET /cases/{caseId}/document-checklist without naming the story that publishes its baseline.
legacy_ref: RWB-E2-024 (AC1 to AC15, X7, X8, X9, section 13)
proposed: Add stageCode and routeCode to the Case resource of RWB-P3-E1018-CON, record the authorise request and response shape in the rwb-access API specification, name the checklist contract story in the Ownership Map and the C dependency set, and load the task code, owner role, discretion, due-date parameter and decision code as data rows through the rwb-case administration stories before wave 2 starts.
